_why: Browser drivers that do not need the usual wait, and WHY. Everything else must wait for a condition before it measures - see check_driver_waits and A26-94. Adding a name here is a decision somebody can read; leaving one stale is a failure.

waitsItsOwnWay.check_qc_reports: only sends marks; it never reads the page
waitsItsOwnWay.check_no_undefined_names: loads each page itself, judges it per frame, and reloads the ones that came back busy
